newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus bourse mkt cap up 7.56 pct in June - CSE.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus bourse mkt cap up 7.56 pct in June - CSE.

text.p: The market capitalisation of the Cyprus Stock Exchange (CSE) rose 7.56 percent to 1.163 billion pounds ($2.25 billion) in June, the bourse said on Friday.
The market capitalisation of the exchange, which trades in 88 securities from 43 listed companies, was 1.081 billion pounds in May.

In a monthly report, the CSE said the banking sector accounted for 55.37 percent of the total market capitalisation, followed by the manufacturing sector with 11.39 and the insurance sector 7.73 percent.
The total value of transactions during the month reached 16.8 million pounds, with an average of 839,000 per trading session. This represents a 45.66 percent rise compared to May.
Trading in banking stocks represented 47.77 percent of total value traded, while corporate bonds had the lowest contributioon, with 2.72 percent.
On June 11 the value of transactions reached 2.6 million, which was the highest value traded from the commencement of the operation of the stock exchange on March 29 1996.
During the month the bourse started operating from its new floor, in the same building as its offices in central Nicosia. The floor will be officially inaugurated on July 8.
On June 19 the CSE also granted a permit to Parma Brokerage Limited to join the list of members of the CSE. Parma Brokerage commenced operations on the 23rd of June. ($=0.516 pounds)
